# Q03a development baseline v2

Explicit opt-in; default remains v1. The original 12 retrieval queries, top-k,
labels and scoring definitions are unchanged. Six synthetic developer-authored
assessment/gate cases exercise the real ChatAgent with a fake client.
Not human gold, independent holdout, provider quality, or semantic entailment.
Production freeze is bound to the existing local code commit recorded in freeze.json.
Only exact single-hero scalar questions are assessed. Skills, conditions and
free-text are unassessed; missing structural slots do not prove missing prose.
